title: Congress spreading misleading information on Kishtwar SPO killings, insulting martyrs and Army: Sunil Sharma

ai.summary: J&K opposition leader Sunil Sharma condemned Congress leader Tariq Karra's claim that the Indian Army killed two SPOs in Kishtwar, calling it misleading and an insult to martyrs' families.

facts.claim: Congress is spreading misleading information to shift blame from terrorists to security forces
facts.quote: Congress is spreading misleading information to shift the blame from terrorists to our security forces

facts.claim: SPOs were on duty with SOG, travelling to Army post to relieve jawans
facts.quote: They were SPO on duty with the SOG, travelling to an Army post at Dharna-Marwah to relieve the jawans posted there

facts.claim: Terrorists took SPOs' rifles and ammunition, Pakistani-origin cartridges recovered
facts.quote: terrorists took away the SPOs' rifles along with magazines and ammunition. Pakistani-origin armour-piercing cartridges were recovered from the spot

facts.claim: JK Police released posters of three wanted terrorists with ₹30 lakh reward
facts.quote: J&K Police has released posters of three wanted terrorists with a reward of ₹30 lakh

facts.claim: Karra admitted relying on 'claims' and 'reports' but accused Army
facts.quote: Karra has admitted he is relying on "claims" and "reports," yet he levelled a serious accusation against the Army before the media

ai.background_note: Congress leader Tariq Karra claimed the Indian Army killed two SPOs in Kishtwar, but opposition leader Sunil Sharma refuted this, stating the SPOs were on duty and terrorists took their weapons.
